Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
HCLTech is a global technology company, home to 220,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services.
 Our purpose is to bring together the best of technology and our people to supercharge progress. We’re supercharging progress for everyone, everywhere – our clients, partners and their stakeholders, our people, communities, and the planet.
 We are looking for an experienced Entra ID DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Terraform, PowerShell, GitHub, and CI/CD practices, combined with hands-on experience in Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD). The successful candidate will help drive the transition from manual platform management to a secure, automated, and scalable Infrastructure as Code operating model.
 Key Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform.
Build and support automation using PowerShell 7, Microsoft Graph, and REST APIs.
Develop and manage GitHub-based CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows.
Support Microsoft Entra ID administration, configuration, and migration activities.
Implement testing, deployment, rollback, and operational automation processes.
Create technical documentation, runbooks, and support handover materials.
Collaborate with architects, security, governance, and operational support teams.
 Required Skills 
Strong hands-on experience with Terraform , including modules, state management, and reusable IaC patterns.
Experience with GitHub , pull requests, code reviews, branch protection, and CI/CD pipelines.
Proficiency in PowerShell 7 , REST APIs, JSON, and YAML.
Practical experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) , application registrations, service principals, and Microsoft Graph.
Understanding of authentication and identity protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, or Federation .
Experience delivering enterprise-scale automation and infrastructure solutions.
 Nice to Have 
Conditional Access, PIM, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, or Entitlement Management.
Microsoft365DSC.
Azure Landing Zones or broader cloud engineering experience.
Identity or application migration projects.
Experience working in regulated or highly governed environments.
 Ideal Candidate 
5+ years of experience in Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, or Automation Engineering.
Strong Infrastructure as Code and automation mindset.
Comfortable working across security, architecture, and operations teams.
Able to deliver secure, maintainable, and scalable solutions while producing clear technical documentation.
 Why Us? 
We are investing in your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at every level to help you find your spark;
We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good work-life balance and real flexibility;
Our company is extremely diverse with representation of 165 nationalities;
We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues across the globe;
We offer comprehensive benefits for all employees;
We are a certified great place to work and a top employer in 25 countries including Romania, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect;
 What do we offer? 
1066 RON monthly budget in Benefit Online Platform
25 vacation days/year.
Life Insurance cover.
The employees working on bank holidays will benefit either a paid day off in the next 30 days + 100% of the hourly base salary for that specific day OR 200% of the hourly base salary for that specific day.
Childbirth allowance of 7000 RON after 1 year in HCLTech.
In the first 8 weeks, the company will pay the difference of up to 100% for the parental leave granted to pregnant employees.
Unfortunate events allowance of 7000 RON for first degree relative granted from day 1 in HCLTech.
Internal trainings and certifications.
